svg.desc: Terminal-style GitHub profile banner for Archisman Chakraborty (Zenith, @AlgorithSage), with an ASCII portrait of him in sunglasses. ML researcher and full-stack developer, Project Head at IEM Research Foundation, leads AlgoZeniths, B.Tech CSE at IEM Kolkata. Projects: Oryonix AI, CureBird, ProgyNovaAI, FaktriIQ.
